items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But then Mattie he didn't want Zutty to come out and he told Max you know.

ctx.x: Claude Hopkins was playing piano that night because Bobby Pratt had laid off or something. And I told Maxie, I said man, you're a phony! He said, what you say? I said, I say you're a phony! Because he told me that he was going to have Marshall to soften it down a little.
But then Mattie he didn't want Zutty to come out and he told Max you know.
